breadcrumb: Appendix B: Prosperity Council Survey Questions
tldr: Appendix B presents the survey instrument used by Governor Kotek's Prosperity Council—an outside advisory group developing recommendations on business climate, workforce, and tools for growth. The statewide survey, open through March 20, 2026, collected input from stakeholders across regions and industries through demographic questions, business/organization details, and structured prompts on challenges, solutions, and success metrics in each focus area. All responses became part of the public record.

bullets.text: Council meetings began January 2026 and conclude June 2026
Survey was open through March 20, 2026 for stakeholder input
Council includes representatives from different regions, key industries, and labor
Three main focus areas: business climate, workforce, and tools for growth
All survey responses included in public record
Respondents categorized by Oregon-based team headcount: 1-20, 21-100, 101-500, 500-1000, 1000+ people
Survey asks who must act (legislature, local governments, employers, education/training partners) to implement solutions
